description: Kings pay the same as carters

participation.context: Chose the eggs, chose the wedding, and would not hear a Rose receipt.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Stayed in the king long enough to make the tapster kneel, then agreed to come out of him.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Priced both plates at sixpence, and made the king pay sooner than a carter's habit.
participation.name: Agnes Tipping

participation.context: Named the nun and the bear-baiting, and was answered with a wedding.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Ralph Raye reported a fair restless yard and the road to Shoreditch, and stopped before a figure.
participation.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

relations.quote: Kings pay the same as carters, Master Richard, and sooner.

relations.quote: I have no number for you.

story.body: You let Richard have his knee, and you let Agnes have the sixpence. You took Raye's restless yard with no sum attached. You preferred a wedding to a baiting, and you did not pretend the jaw had improved.
